ring-telemetryops.name: Ring TelemetryOps
ring-telemetryops.summary: Diagnostic agent for Ring video doorbells, built for the Amazon Developer Hackathon 2026. A Digital Twin of the doorbell lets you inject faults (dirty lens, stuck IR filter, 50/60 Hz flicker, a power cut) and the agent diagnoses them from OpenCV measurements, a deterministic pre-check and Claude Haiku 4.5 on Amazon Bedrock. A local fallback keeps the same report contract when Bedrock is unavailable, and a read-only mode runs against Ring's Partner API. Backed by 869 pytest and 195 Node tests, per the README.
ring-telemetryops.fact: 869 pytest + 195 Node tests, per the README

hybrid-rag-api.name: Hybrid RAG API
hybrid-rag-api.summary: A hybrid RAG engine written from scratch, without LangChain or LlamaIndex. Dense search (pgvector, HNSW) and lexical search (PostgreSQL GIN) are fused with Reciprocal Rank Fusion, and the prompt requires a document-and-page citation for every claim. A question can be scoped to one document or run across all of them, with multi-turn memory.
hybrid-rag-api.fact: RRF with k = 60 over HNSW and GIN

ring-telemetryops.tagline: Measure first, reason second: OpenCV grades the stream, and Claude on Bedrock only steps in when something is wrong.

stats.label: findings logged on Ring's Partner API

decisions: Retrieval by measured signals, not by similarity
A Digital Twin, because Ring's API exposes no Wi-Fi signal or voltage
ring-telemetryops.diagramDesc: A camera stream is measured by OpenCV, graded by a deterministic pre-check, and only anomalies reach knowledge-base retrieval and Claude on Bedrock; a local fallback keeps the same report contract.
steps: A heartbeat checks every metric each 15 s in the Digital Twin (critical at once, degraded after three in a row); a doorbell ring, motion or live view triggers an analysis straight away.
A frame from the camera stream (or the Digital Twin simulator) is analysed by OpenCV: frame rate, bitrate, brightness, sharpness and banding.
A deterministic pre-check grades each metric against thresholds kept in one JSON file.
Nominal results return a healthy report without calling the model.
Anomalies trigger ranking of 15 troubleshooting procedures by the measured signals.
Claude Haiku 4.5 on Amazon Bedrock reasons over the keyframe, metrics and procedures.
The answer is validated against a report contract with one corrective retry.
Severity and root-cause domain come from the pre-check: if the model disagrees, the deterministic value replaces it.
If Bedrock is unavailable, a local fallback produces the same report schema, labelled as such.

hybrid-rag-api.tagline: Answers over PDFs where every claim cites its document and page, built from scratch without LangChain.
decisions: RRF instead of a weighted sum
hybrid-rag-api.diagramDesc: PDFs are chunked and embedded into PostgreSQL; each question runs vector and full-text search in parallel, fuses them with RRF and asks Gemini for an answer with page citations.
steps: A PDF is uploaded through FastAPI and split by page, then into overlapping chunks.
Chunks are embedded with gemini-embedding-001 in concurrent batches of up to 100, with exponential backoff on HTTP 429 and 503.
Text and 768-dimensional vectors are stored in PostgreSQL 16 with an HNSW index and a GIN full-text index (Spanish configuration).
A question runs dense and lexical search concurrently.
Reciprocal Rank Fusion (k = 60) merges both rankings.
The top chunks and the conversation history go to Gemini at temperature 0.
The prompt requires a document-and-page citation for every claim.

wakemap.tagline: Location alarms that fire when you reach your stop with the app open, plus an AI travel guide. My dissertation prototype.
decisions: The key stays on the server
Structured output the app can trust
wakemap.diagramDesc: The Flutter app handles alarms, voice input and maps on the device and calls a Node.js proxy for Gemini; maps and routes come from OpenStreetMap, Nominatim and OSRM.
steps: The Flutter app runs two modes: commuter alarms and a traveller guide.
While the app is open, commuter alarms compare the device's position with a 100 to 1,000 m radius and fire a local notification.
Spoken alarms are transcribed on the device and sent to the Node.js proxy.
The proxy, which holds the API key, asks Gemini for structured JSON.
Traveller plans come back with stops, coordinates, duration and budget.
Places are geocoded with Nominatim and routes drawn with OSRM on OpenStreetMap tiles.

output.title: A little about me
about: I'm Ernesto, a Software Engineer focused on AI. I build intelligent systems, from retrieval and agents to the backend infrastructure behind them.
I'm looking for an AI engineering role where I can take retrieval and agent systems to production, in a team that cares about reliability.
Based in Madrid · Open to relocation.

points: Developed an AI-powered personal tutor integrating institutional data from Snowflake with OpenAI models on Azure, tested with approximately 20 real users.

agent.title: Ask about Ernesto
agent.label: Your question
agent.how: This agent answers with an LLM (GPT-OSS on Groq) through a small Cloudflare function, and is told to use only facts taken from this site. The lookups you see run on the site's own data. If the LLM is unreachable, a BM25 matcher in your browser answers with pre-written replies instead. Nothing is stored.
